message: The meaning of the [{1}] attribute on '{0}' is ambiguous because the inequality strictness is not specified. It is now interpreted as {4}, which is non-standard, and this behavior might be changed in the future. Use either [{2}] or [{3}], or specify the DefaultInequalityStrictness property in ContractOptions using the ConfigureContracts fabric extension method.
rationale: The declaration placeholder {0} is not quoted, unlike the other contract diagnostics ('{0}' in LAMA5001 and LAMA5006), which makes the rendered text 'on C.A is ambiguous' hard to read; the list of options also lacks a comma before the final alternative.
